description: This file defines a custom Blazor input component that extends the InputSelect component to add support for parsing integer values from strings, as a polyfill for missing native support in certain Blazor versions.

classes.name: CustomInputSelect<TValue>
classes.description: A custom Blazor input component that extends InputSelect to parse string input into TValue, specifically adding support for integers.

methods.name: TryParseValueFromString
methods.description: Overrides the base method to parse string input into the TValue, with special handling for integer types to convert string to int.
